C1158.title: Kuaishou Penalized with Warning for Inadequate Implementation of Youth Mode
C1158.summary: On November 22, 2024, public security authorities issued a warning penalty to Kuaishou under the Cybersecurity Law after the platform failed to promptly remove prohibited information and inadequately enforced its youth mode, leading to the spread of illegal content harmful to minors. The authorities ordered a comprehensive cleanup of illegal information and sanctions against offending accounts.
